note: post-login: queries mounted by the route change after the login response; their observers subscribe in passive effects flushed on React's scheduler with no receipt reaching those fibers (abstention)

post-login batch: react-query observers of the newly routed chat view, subscribed in effects flushed on React's scheduler message (a 'scheduler' lineage) without a receipt on their fibers (abstention)

health check: timer armed by useHealthCheck's effect (client/src/data-provider/connection.ts:12-42, via Root.tsx:48 useHealthCheck(isAuthenticated)) when isAuthenticated flips after login; the effect is flushed on React's scheduler with no receipt reaching Root, so the timer is created unowned. A recall abstention downstream of login, not a timer armed before any action.
react-query refetch of the conversation after the stream finished: created by the stream's end handler through query invalidation flushed on the scheduler without a receipt (abstention)
stream status poll created after the stream ended, from an effect flushed on the scheduler without a receipt (abstention)
after agent create: queries for the newly selected agent mounted by the panel re-render; observers subscribed in scheduler-flushed effects whose fibers carry no receipt (abstention)

title fetch after the first reply: attributed state_effect to the send in the telemetry-off run and in both fifth-pass runs, unattributed here. The receipt that carries it can be consumed by an unrelated commit before the owning render (pendingReceipts is cleared at the end of every commit walk), so recall here is timing-dependent (abstention, not a wrong credit)
